title: refactor(react,plugin-form,console): read visibleWhen only — spec 18 retires the form view's visibleOn and the page component's visibility
body:
Fixes #12654
Clause-②: no

## What changes

`@objectstack/spec` 18 retires the form view field's and section's `visibleOn` and the page component's `visibility` as `retiredKey` tombstones naming `visibleWhen` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23543 F4, landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23836). The objectui readers of those spec keys stop folding them back:

- **`@object-ui/react`**: `SchemaRenderer` drops the `visibility` leg of its visibility chain, the `visibility` member of its working-copy type, and its prop strip. `BaseSchema`'s own deprecated `visibleOn` is a different key (the spec's page component never declared it) and is still read.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`**: `normalizeSectionField` carries a spec form field's `visibleWhen` only into the runtime field's view-level slot. The runtime `FormField`'s own `visibleOn` slot (the gate `form.tsx` evaluates) is a different key and is unchanged.
- **console**: `FormPage` builds field and section rows from `visibleWhen` only (`/forms/:name` and the public `/f/:slug`).

## The narrowing (Clause-② reason)

A raw schema handed to these readers without passing through the spec's parse, carrying only the retired key, is no longer honoured: the field, section or node draws. Served metadata is unaffected, because it already reaches objectui with `visibleWhen`: the spec's parse folds the old key through the 18 pre-releases, and spec 18's stored-row rehydration rewrites a stored row. Each narrowing is pinned beside its control (the same predicate under `visibleWhen` does hide):
- `FormPage.visibleWhen.test.tsx` and `FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx` (field and section);
- `sectionFields.test.ts` ("does not read the retired spec-field `visibleOn`");
- `SchemaRenderer.expressions.test.tsx` ("does not read the retired `visibility` key").

Ablations (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restores proven blob == HEAD): putting back `?? fd.visibleOn` gives 2 failed; `?? override.visibleOn` gives 2 failed; `?? sec.visibleOn` gives 2 failed; the `visibility` leg gives 1 failed. A first `visibility` attempt was refused by the tool (the anchor was not consumed) and did not run.

## The three spec-shape couplings

- `sectionFields.spec-parity.test.ts`: the key set is read through a pipe when there is one (`.in` on next.2, the plain object on 18). The `visibleOn` row now asserts the normalizer drops it; the key stays in the spec's shape on both lines (deprecated alias, then tombstone).
- `SchemaRenderer.expressions.test.tsx`: the probe node declares `visibility` itself instead of picking `PageComponent`'s `visibility` member, which is `never` on 18.
- `flat-props-refusal-10872.test.ts`: already walks pipe and lazy, and holds unchanged. `PAGE_COMPONENT_NODE_KEYS` keeps `visibility` because spec 18 still carries it as a shape key.

Green against the installed `18.0.0-next.2`. The spec-18 leg is NOT MEASURED (18 is not installed); the walks hold for a plain closed object by construction.

## Census (H1)

`form.tsx`'s `visibleOn` reads and `WizardForm`'s are the RUNTIME field's slot, which `sectionFields.ts` fills from the spec's `visibleWhen`; they are unchanged. The spec-field reader is `sectionFields.ts`. It sits outside the claim's listed surface and is fixed in place under the bounded same-class exemption (one expression, no other claim on the file, same gate family as the spec-parity coupling already in the surface). The claim's file surface needs `packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`, `sectionFields.test.ts` and `sectionFields.blankGate-11262.test.ts` added. `CommandPalette` (command items), `cli check` (BaseSchema vocabulary) and `@object-ui/types` (no spec key declared live) are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- metadata-admin's `SchemaForm.readVisibility` still reads `visibleWhen ?? visibleOn`, because the designer's own create and anchor schemas write `visibleOn` into in-app layouts (not saved metadata). Left for its own card.
- `normalizeSectionField`'s string shorthand reads an object field's `visibleOn`, a key the spec FieldSchema does not declare. Dormant; noted only.
- `BaseSchema.visibleOn` (objectui's own deprecated alias) is not this card.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` reports 2 errors on changed files; both are present on the base.
